verdict.rationale: Expensify's own 'Ask Expensify AI anything' material says users can create, categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses, configure workspaces and build rules, and query account data, all in plain language. This covers operating the product through natural-language commands. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond blog marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operations work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
